description: Adapter routing robustness: unrecognized, missing, empty, case-mismatched, and non-string feature selectors are normalized to a deterministic unknown_feature error that echoes the requested feature string (empty when absent or non-string).

input.scenario: feature key entirely absent from the command
case-mismatched real feature name must not match (case-sensitive routing)
algorithm name supplied where a feature name is expected
feature name with an internal space does not match union_find
non-string feature value coerces to empty
